behavior: Optional x/y percentages preserve legacy evaluation shape when absent.
Concurrent cues have independent reused text nodes, textContent rendering, and canvas-relative centered positions.
Ready, paused and retained-completed preview cues can be dragged under a current unpaused lease; gameplay/playing/detached state disables hit targets.
Final pointerup samples the endpoint once; cancel/blur/Escape/stale map, generation, time, document or lease cancels without an edit.
Successful edit updates the child document immutably before posting the indexed cue identity and previous position to Studio.
Center layout uses no transformed ancestor and fits ordinary cue hit areas to text; wheel input is untouched.

existing.note: These ran on the same game/document production source before only the new DOM helper received final center hit-area and consecutive-drag refresh changes; new8 were rerun after those helper changes.

Pointer cancel, window blur, Escape, playing/gameplay/retained state and stale ownership cleanup.
